propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs AcliClient without validating presence of JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN, allowing silent construction with empty credentials that fail only at first API call
Cloud adapter lacks the construction-time credential guard that DC adapter implements via assert_env_ready and transport.py, creating test-parity gap
JIRA_USER must be validated as an email format (contain @ with non-empty local and domain parts) before construction, as Cloud authenticates with Atlassian account email via Basic-auth
test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly currently pins silent-build behaviour and must be flipped to assert loud BackendEnvError
test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance uses non-email user fixture that would fail new validation, requiring fixture update to valid email to still reach conformance assertion
